company.name: Blockscout
company.shortDescription: Blockscout is a powerful open-source blockchain explorer and analytics platform.
company.description: Blockscout is a powerful open-source blockchain explorer and analytics platform designed for inspecting, analyzing, and interacting with EVM-based blockchain networks such as Ethereum, Optimism, Arbitrum, Base, and other Layer 1, Layer 2, and rollup ecosystems. It provides developers, researchers, and crypto users with transparent access to on-chain data through a modern multichain interface.

productsAndServices.description: An open-source block explorer that enables searching, tracking, and analyzing blockchain data across multiple EVM-based networks in a unified interface.
productsAndServices.name: Blockscout Multichain Block Explorer

productsAndServices.description: Provides tools for verifying, publishing, reading, writing, and interacting with smart contracts and proxies on EVM-based blockchains.
productsAndServices.name: Smart Contract Verification and Interaction

productsAndServices.description: An integrated marketplace within Blockscout for discovering, exploring, and interacting with decentralized applications across multiple blockchain networks.
productsAndServices.name: DAppscout - Decentralized Application Marketplace

productsAndServices.description: Offers REST and JSON RPC APIs, tagging, debuggers, and other developer tools to access blockchain data and interact with smart contracts.
productsAndServices.name: APIs and Developer Tools

productsAndServices.description: Displays real-time network statistics including gas fees and granular blockchain trends to inform onchain decisions.
productsAndServices.name: Network Statistics and Gas Fee Tracking
